curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: respond to direct and indirect questions from a text to show comprehension

mission.title: respond to direct and indirect questions from a text to show comprehension

interactions.prompt: Read: Wanjiku has a blue cup. What colour is the cup?
interactions.feedback: Yes! The text directly says the cup is blue.
interactions.retryHint: Find the colour word in the sentence.

interactions.prompt: Read: Musa put on boots and carried an umbrella. What was the weather probably like?
interactions.feedback: Correct! The boots and umbrella are clues that it was rainy.
interactions.retryHint: Think about when people use an umbrella and boots.

interactions.prompt: Read: Naliaka fed the hen, then collected two eggs. Sort each question by its kind.
objects: Why might she carry the eggs carefully?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a question, then tap its kind.
interactions.feedback: Great! One answer is stated; the other needs thinking from clues.
interactions.retryHint: Check whether the exact answer appears in the text.

interactions.prompt: Read: The bell rang. Otieno packed his books and walked home. Where did Otieno go?
interactions.feedback: Well read! The text directly says he walked home.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the final words of the text.

interactions.prompt: Read: Amina shared her orange with Neema, who had no snack. What does this show about Amina?
interactions.feedback: Excellent thinking! Sharing with Neema shows kindness.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what sharing tells us about a person.

interactions.prompt: Read: Kamau watered the dry seedlings. By evening, their leaves stood up. Match each question to its answer.
objects: Why did the leaves stand up?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a question, then tap its answer.
interactions.feedback: Super comprehension! You answered one direct and one indirect question.
interactions.retryHint: Use the exact words for the first answer and the cause-and-effect clue for the second.
